lessons_used: Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins.
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 6 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6), though 10 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, adoption hint, and single-test categories.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Status Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the rendering waiting step into a full-bleed stage layout featuring a live desktop preview animation while pet assets compile in the background.
candidates.why: The home wait step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), and wait_info/home stage improvements produced 4 historical winning tests.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Control Instructions Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated new screen at the end of onboarding displaying clear checklist instructions on using the system tray to control, show, or hide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support tickets show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to pets (3 emails) and desktop feature misbehavior (4 emails).

new_tray_guide.headline: Managing Your Desktop Pet
new_tray_guide.body: Use the system tray icon anytime to summon, hide, or adjust pet interaction settings on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new instructional screen after home_intro while retaining all required onboarding steps is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: New screens at finish step historically show negative lift (-1.7%).

candidates.title: Path Option Cards Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path selection interface using an interactive stage layout with animated character preview cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step sees a 20.4% drop-off with a mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation when picking a path.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Trait Demonstration Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive demonstration flow on the final welcome screen showing live desktop pet cursor reactions before finishing setup.
candidates.why: Users frequently contact support post-setup about confusion controlling or interacting with their desktop pet.

new_demo_flow.headline: Test Pet Reactions
new_demo_flow.body: Hover over your pet to see live reactions before completing setup.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Account Sync Reassurance
candidates.change: Add a prominent sync reassurance hint explaining that signing into an existing account immediately retrieves and restores existing pets and progress.
candidates.why: The top support theme is pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 support emails).

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account will automatically restore all your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adding an informational sync reassurance hint to the sign-in screen is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Top support theme addressed with a proven sign-in hint pattern (+1.4% avg).

candidates.title: Desktop Render Activity Progress Status Stream
candidates.change: Display a dynamic status activity text component on the waiting screen explaining current background generation stages such as asset extraction and desktop tray hookup.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s, and wait_info changes have driven 4 past test wins.

components.text: Hooking pet assets into OS system tray...

guard.reason: Adding dynamic generation activity status information to the waiting screen is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info is a reliable winning category with 4 past wins (+1.1% avg).

candidates.title: Photo Lighting and Angle Guidance Notice
candidates.change: Add a clear photo quality hint recommending high-contrast lighting and clear front angles to avoid custom pet generation errors.
candidates.why: Support mail logged 3 reports of custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption is the main funnel drop point (66.2% conversion).

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear photos with direct lighting and visible pet facial features.

guard.reason: Adding photo guidance hints to the upload photos screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff step, but adoption hints have trended negative (-1.3%).

candidates.title: Desktop Trait Mastery Bonus Incentive
candidates.change: Add a visual badge incentive on the final welcome screen highlighting unlocked starter desktop animation items.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 75.6% with mean completion times of 5815s; incentives help drive final step completion.

components.text: Bonus Unlocked: Starter Desktop Animation Pack

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Bonus Unlocked', violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning discounts, gifts, bonuses, or free extras.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Ready Desktop Alert Notification
candidates.change: Enable an optional desktop alert system prompt on the render screen that notifies users when rendering completes if the app is minimized.
candidates.why: Long background render times (median 201s, mean 2336s) cause users to minimize the app and lose track of onboarding.

waiting.hint: We will send a system notification as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding an optional completion notification prompt on the waiting screen is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home notification changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Split Stage Adoption Certificate View
candidates.change: Reorganize the adoption certificate screen into a split layout separating pet summary details from naming and confirmation controls.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off (66.2% conversion), indicating layout friction during certificate completion.

guard.reason: Reorganizing the adoption certificate screen layout without removing required elements or function is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff step, but adoption layout redesigns consistently underperform.
